name: web-black-agency-about-page-with-large-serif-copy-team-grid-and-awards
title: Black and white agency about page: big light paragraph, team photo grid in black tees, stats, awards list, testimonial and footer form
whatItIs: A tall page with a black top half (nav, 'About us.' title, small copy, a large light paragraph and two office photos) and a white lower half: 'Our Members' with a 3x3 grid of grey portrait photos in black tops, a stats grid, 'Nominated as Agency of the Year' with an award list, a testimonial with logos and a black footer 'Got a project? Let's talk. Hi,' with an inline name field.
whatItMeans: Confident and quiet; big light type and uniform portraits feel like a serious studio.
techniques: Set a large light paragraph as the manifesto.
Shoot the team in uniform black on grey.
Use an inline form field in the footer headline.
Show awards as a hairline list.

vocabulary.definition: Team photos with the same crop, colour and backdrop.
Titles with year and body on hairlines.
An input placed inside a headline.
